CustomField.description: The date this deal ENTERED its current stage. NAME AND SHAPE MIRROR Opportunity.Stage_Entry_Date__c AND OpportunityStageEntryService DELIBERATELY - the concept already has an established name, a working before-context stamp, a selector read and a backfill script in this org, and inventing Stage_Entered_Date__c would give one concept two names. Re-stamped, not preserved, on re-entry: the clock restarts. Stamped by Apex in Phase 2 on every writer, so do NOT add an if-null guard - the Opportunity service records that such a guard silently reintroduces the bug it was meant to fix. Deploys with FieldPermissions for NOBODY, System Administrator included, so its permission-set grant is part of the work.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically when the deal Stage changes. Do not edit unless correcting a known data error.
CustomField.label: Stage Entry Date
